$comment: Usage notes and type styles for the design system (M100.1). scripts/design-system/build.ts reads every value from src/styles/tokens/*.css; this file holds only what CSS cannot say. A token with no note fails the build.

color.n-0: Base neutral. App ground and raised cards (via surface-app / surface-raised), secondary-button and input fills. Dark: the darkest app surface.
color.n-25: Board ground (surface-board), hover wash on select triggers.
color.n-50: Sunken wells, hover washes on buttons and menu rows, code and kbd grounds, disabled inputs.
color.n-100: Segmented-control track, pressed washes, empty-state icon-well border, quiet dividers. Dark: raised surfaces.
color.n-200: Hairlines (border-subtle): cards, menus, tags, select triggers.
color.n-300: Control borders (border-strong): inputs, secondary buttons, switch track off. Scrollbar thumb.
color.n-400: Disabled ink, placeholder icons and chevrons. Not for readable text: 3.4:1 on n-0 in light.
color.n-500: Icon strokes in menus and inputs; tag remove glyph.
color.n-600: Readable secondary text, metadata and placeholders (text-secondary/meta). Ghost button and icon-button ink.
color.n-700: Tag and status-chip labels; menu item text.
color.n-800: Strong body ink: secondary-button label, dialog body, hovered ghost buttons.
color.n-900: Primary text (text-primary); tooltip ground in light theme.
color.cortex-50: Selected-row and selected-node ground (surface-selected). Pairs with cortex-700 ink.
color.cortex-100: Text selection highlight; hover on an active icon button.
color.cortex-200: Cortex ultramarine, step 200. The primary brand ramp: links, focus, selection and the accent.
color.cortex-300: Dark theme link ink (text-link) and diagram selection ring.
color.cortex-400: Dark theme focus border and accent hover.
color.cortex-500: THE accent: focus border, links (light), switch on, filled cortex controls. Holds a white label at 5.6:1 in both themes.
color.cortex-600: Link ink at 12–13px (concept and source links), active icon-button glyph, menu check marks; AA on every neutral surface in both themes. Dark: #899df1, too light for a white label, so hover fills on it carry n-0 ink.
color.cortex-700: Ink on a cortex-50 ground (selected sidebar row, block chips). Dark: becomes the light 200 tint.
color.cortex-800: Cortex ultramarine, step 800. The primary brand ramp: links, focus, selection and the accent.
color.cortex-900: Cortex ultramarine, step 900. The primary brand ramp: links, focus, selection and the accent.
color.synapse-50: AI surface ground (surface-ai): assistant cards, AI blocks. AI only.
color.synapse-100: Synapse violet, step 100. AI surfaces ONLY: never for non-AI chrome.
color.synapse-200: Synapse violet, step 200. AI surfaces ONLY: never for non-AI chrome.
color.synapse-300: Dark theme AI ink (text-ai). AI only.
color.synapse-400: Synapse violet, step 400. AI surfaces ONLY: never for non-AI chrome.
color.synapse-500: AI tone icon (toasts, sparkles). AI only.
color.synapse-600: AI ink (text-ai in light; text-synapse-600 in both themes); AA on every neutral surface. AI only.
color.synapse-700: AI ink on a synapse-50 ground. AI only.
color.success-50: Success banner and row ground; pairs with success-700 ink.
color.success-500: Success icon and dot. Not for body text on white.
color.success-600: Success text on every neutral surface, both themes (AA, contrast.test.ts).
color.success-700: Success ink on success-50 (and on neutral surfaces).
color.warn-50: Warning banner and row ground; pairs with warn-700 ink.
color.warn-500: Warning icon and dot. Not for body text on white.
color.warn-600: Warning text on every neutral surface, both themes (AA). Amber only reaches 4.5:1 near the 700 step, so 600 and 700 sit close in light.
color.warn-700: Warning ink on warn-50 (and on neutral surfaces).
color.danger-50: Danger banner and row ground; pairs with danger-700 ink.
color.danger-200: Error banner border on danger-50; unavailable-section border.
color.danger-500: Danger icon and dot. Not for body text on white.
color.danger-600: Destructive menu item text; danger text on every neutral surface (AA).
color.danger-700: Danger ink on danger-50 (and on neutral surfaces).
color.ent-objective: Entity identity colour for Objective records: icons and dots, never text.
color.ent-keyresult: Entity identity colour for Key result records: icons and dots, never text.
color.ent-initiative: Entity identity colour for Initiative records: icons and dots, never text.
color.ent-feature: Entity identity colour for Feature records: icons and dots, never text.
color.ent-subfeature: Entity identity colour for Sub-feature records: icons and dots, never text.
color.ent-product: Entity identity colour for Product records: icons and dots, never text.
color.ent-component: Entity identity colour for Component records: icons and dots, never text.
color.ent-release: Entity identity colour for Release records: icons and dots, never text.
color.ent-releasegroup: Entity identity colour for Release group records: icons and dots, never text.
color.ent-company: Entity identity colour for Company records: icons and dots, never text.
color.ent-user: Entity identity colour for User records: icons and dots, never text.
color.swatch-amber: User-assignable swatch (amber): type icons, kanban cards, timeline bars, tag dots. A fill, never text on white.
color.swatch-blue: User-assignable swatch (blue): type icons, kanban cards, timeline bars, tag dots. A fill, never text on white.
color.swatch-teal: User-assignable swatch (teal): type icons, kanban cards, timeline bars, tag dots. A fill, never text on white.
color.swatch-green: User-assignable swatch (green): type icons, kanban cards, timeline bars, tag dots. A fill, never text on white.
color.swatch-violet: User-assignable swatch (violet): type icons, kanban cards, timeline bars, tag dots. A fill, never text on white.
color.swatch-magenta: User-assignable swatch (magenta): type icons, kanban cards, timeline bars, tag dots. A fill, never text on white.
color.swatch-vermilion: User-assignable swatch (vermilion): type icons, kanban cards, timeline bars, tag dots. A fill, never text on white.
color.swatch-sky: User-assignable swatch (sky): type icons, kanban cards, timeline bars, tag dots. A fill, never text on white.
color.opt-gray: Option colour gray: the dot / solid fill of a select option, tag or workflow status.
color.opt-gray-bg: Pill ground behind a gray tag (about 13% of the hue).
color.opt-gray-ink: Text on opt-gray-bg; holds at least 4.5:1 on it in both themes.
color.opt-brown: Option colour brown: the dot / solid fill of a select option, tag or workflow status.
color.opt-brown-bg: Pill ground behind a brown tag (about 13% of the hue).
color.opt-brown-ink: Text on opt-brown-bg; holds at least 4.5:1 on it in both themes.
color.opt-orange: Option colour orange: the dot / solid fill of a select option, tag or workflow status.
color.opt-orange-bg: Pill ground behind a orange tag (about 13% of the hue).
color.opt-orange-ink: Text on opt-orange-bg; holds at least 4.5:1 on it in both themes.
color.opt-yellow: Option colour yellow: the dot / solid fill of a select option, tag or workflow status.
color.opt-yellow-bg: Pill ground behind a yellow tag (about 13% of the hue).
color.opt-yellow-ink: Text on opt-yellow-bg; holds at least 4.5:1 on it in both themes.
color.opt-green: Option colour green: the dot / solid fill of a select option, tag or workflow status.
color.opt-green-bg: Pill ground behind a green tag (about 13% of the hue).
color.opt-green-ink: Text on opt-green-bg; holds at least 4.5:1 on it in both themes.
color.opt-blue: Option colour blue: the dot / solid fill of a select option, tag or workflow status.
color.opt-blue-bg: Pill ground behind a blue tag (about 13% of the hue).
color.opt-blue-ink: Text on opt-blue-bg; holds at least 4.5:1 on it in both themes.
color.opt-purple: Option colour purple: the dot / solid fill of a select option, tag or workflow status.
color.opt-purple-bg: Pill ground behind a purple tag (about 13% of the hue).
color.opt-purple-ink: Text on opt-purple-bg; holds at least 4.5:1 on it in both themes.
color.opt-pink: Option colour pink: the dot / solid fill of a select option, tag or workflow status.
color.opt-pink-bg: Pill ground behind a pink tag (about 13% of the hue).
color.opt-pink-ink: Text on opt-pink-bg; holds at least 4.5:1 on it in both themes.
color.opt-red: Option colour red: the dot / solid fill of a select option, tag or workflow status.
color.opt-red-bg: Pill ground behind a red tag (about 13% of the hue).
color.opt-red-ink: Text on opt-red-bg; holds at least 4.5:1 on it in both themes.
color.action-primary: Filled primary button. Graphite in light, near-white in dark.
color.on-action-primary: Label on action-primary (and its hover/press), both themes.
color.avatar-1: Avatar ground #1, picked by a hash of the name. White initials clear 4.5:1.
color.avatar-2: Avatar ground #2, picked by a hash of the name. White initials clear 4.5:1.
color.avatar-3: Avatar ground #3, picked by a hash of the name. White initials clear 4.5:1.
color.avatar-4: Avatar ground #4, picked by a hash of the name. White initials clear 4.5:1.
color.avatar-5: Avatar ground #5, picked by a hash of the name. White initials clear 4.5:1.
color.avatar-6: Avatar ground #6, picked by a hash of the name. White initials clear 4.5:1.
color.avatar-7: Avatar ground #7, picked by a hash of the name. White initials clear 4.5:1.
color.avatar-8: Avatar ground #8, picked by a hash of the name. White initials clear 4.5:1.
color.status-idea: Workflow status flag fill: New idea. Glyph colour only; the label carries the meaning.
color.status-planned: Workflow status flag fill: Planned. Glyph colour only; the label carries the meaning.
color.status-progress: Workflow status flag fill: In progress. Glyph colour only; the label carries the meaning.
color.status-validation: Workflow status flag fill: Validation. Glyph colour only; the label carries the meaning.
color.status-released: Workflow status flag fill: Released. Glyph colour only; the label carries the meaning.
color.status-wontdo: Workflow status flag fill: Won't do. Glyph colour only; the label carries the meaning.
color.health-on: Health dot: on track. Always paired with a word.
color.health-risk: Health dot: at risk. Always paired with a word.
color.health-off: Health dot: off track. Always paired with a word.
color.surface-frame: Window frame and the icon rail: a step darker than navigation.
color.surface-navigation: Context sidebar background; the canvas’s rounded corner rests on it.
color.surface-board: Whiteboard and board views; a breath off surface-app.
color.surface-sunken: Sunken wells: state messages, code, inset panels.
color.surface-raised: Cards, menus, popovers, dialogs. Light: white on a tinted ground; dark: lighter than the ground.
color.canvas-dot: Whiteboard dot grid: 1px dots on a 24px pitch over surface-board.
color.canvas-1: JSON Canvas preset colour 1 (red); files store only the digit.
color.canvas-2: JSON Canvas preset colour 2 (orange); files store only the digit.
color.canvas-3: JSON Canvas preset colour 3 (yellow); files store only the digit.
color.canvas-4: JSON Canvas preset colour 4 (green); files store only the digit.
color.canvas-5: JSON Canvas preset colour 5 (cyan); files store only the digit.
color.canvas-6: JSON Canvas preset colour 6 (purple); files store only the digit.
color.text-primary: Body and title text on every surface-* ground, both themes.
color.text-secondary: Secondary text on every neutral surface, both themes (≥4.5:1).
color.text-muted: Muted helper text; same value as text-secondary so it stays readable.
color.text-meta: Metadata (timestamps, counts) on every neutral surface.
color.text-disabled: Disabled labels only. Deliberately below 4.5:1: never for content.
color.text-inverse: Always white: labels on accent, cortex-500 fills and avatar grounds, both themes. Replaces text-white. Not for tooltips (they use n-0 on n-900).
color.text-link: Links on surface-app, surface-raised and surface-sunken.
color.text-ai: AI-attributed text on surface-app and surface-ai. AI only.
color.border-subtle: Default hairline: cards, menus, tags, dividers.
color.border-focus: Focus border on every control; paired with the ring shadow.
color.diagram-selection-ring: Ring around a selected diagram node (on cortex-50).
color.accent: Brand accent: switch on, focus, filled cortex controls. White label on it.

spacing.sp-2: Default gap between inline controls and nav-row parts.
spacing.sp-4: Card and state-message padding; narrow composition inset.
spacing.sp-6: Dialog body inset; composition inset from 600px.
spacing.sp-12: Bottom breathing room under page content.
spacing.sp-16: Largest step: section separation on Home.

radius.r-sm: Tags, status chips, icon buttons, menu rows, segments, tooltips.
radius.r-md: Buttons, inputs, selects, nav rows, segmented track, state messages.

shadow.shadow-sm: Resting cards that lift off the ground.
shadow.ring: Focus ring: 3px of accent at 25% (45% in dark), with border-focus.

size.rail-w: Width of the persistent icon rail.
size.sidebar-w: Default width of the resizable context sidebar.
size.surface-broad: Broad measure for databases and Home.
size.control-h: Default control height: buttons md, inputs, selects.

fontWeight.w-medium: Buttons, tags, segment labels, state-message titles.

letterSpacing.track-tight: Dialog and section titles, empty-state headlines.
letterSpacing.track-caps: Uppercase labels (menu groups, AI section labels).

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The page title above a document body (first H1). Compact panes drop to workspace-title.

styles.name: workspace-title
styles.usage: Peek and workspace titles; page titles in compact panes.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section heads, dialog titles, empty-state headlines.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: Captures land here untyped. Giving a note a type is what takes it out of the Inbox.
styles.usage: Document body text in the editor.

styles.name: ui
styles.sample: Every change in this vault is saved to history.
styles.usage: Standard UI text: controls, menus, dialogs, nav rows.

styles.name: text-4xl
styles.usage: Editorial display, kept for authored content only.

styles.name: text-sm
styles.sample: The base UI size of the app body
styles.usage: Base UI: the body default, switches, sidebar rows.

styles.name: text-xs
styles.usage: Tags, status chips, small buttons, segmented labels.

styles.name: text-2xs
styles.usage: Menu hints and current values; uppercase group labels (500).

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Keycaps in tooltips, menus and Settings.
